Well I'm only talking after the action now, but first of all I'd say you should look more to the left, if you want to buy, what would price be approaching then? You can't really see that on your chart, that's talking about reward, what also worries me, what is your risk on this trade, what is your lotsize based on? What I see on this chart is, you are trying to buy above a flip level, above wide range bars,... if price decides to go down to retest it will get to the origin or accumulate around the flip level, it's simply a better risk trade. Also I can't see any FTR's after the engulfs of highs, all this makes me NOT wanting to buy, especially not there

just my point of view...

I've been studying the vast amount of information that is available, and started doing some homework on price caps yesterday. After reading the S/D article again today I'm a bit confused about part 2: S/D as reactions to the FTR.

My only question really is: am I thinking correct when I say a FTR is a FL, but not all FL are FTRs?
